description: Editable bounds for derived activity limits. Ratios are based on patterns in the uploaded steel-sector limits and should be scientifically reviewed.

activity_min_capacity_ratio__standard.description: Observed base-case min activity / equal-capacity bound for standard finishing group. This is a numeric pattern in model data, not an independently validated utilization rate.
activity_min_capacity_ratio__standard.basis: Calculated from basecase 2025 limits; applies to all modeled periods. Adjust after scientific review.
